methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The proposed maturity model is inspired on the Plan-Do-Check-Act cycle approach for continual improvement, and covers well-understood fundamental energy management activities common across energy management texts

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Proposes an energy management maturity model - a qualitative, staged (PDCA-based) framework of management activities organised into five maturity levels and evaluated by an ontology mapping to ISO 50001. No EnPI/EnB measurement model is presented or characterised (no measured/normalised quantity defined via variables, functional form, or estimation approach). 'Energy performance indicators' and 'energy baseline' appear only as a listed activity and as ISO 50001 requirements being mapped - incidental mention. Falls under the v2.3 exclusion for a framework / maturity assessment without EnPI/EnB measurement-model content.

paper_type.evidence_quote: that organizes the essential energy management activities across five maturity levels

stage1.notes: Maturity-model paper (paper_type=maturity model or framework); EnPI/EnB referenced only as activities and ISO 50001 requirements, not modelled. Ineligible under the v2.3 maturity-assessment exclusion. Tier-1 membership-critical call - route to human blind-first review if the two models diverge.
